title: ::: K-IG 교육 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초2 | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ Lesson 43 ]

items.text: The book the cover of which is red is mine.
alternatives: The book of which the cover is red is mine.

items.text: This is the man with whom John lives.
alternatives: This is the person with whom John lives.

items.text: This is the cat by which the rat was killed.
alternatives: This is the cat by which the mouse was killed.

items.text: There are persons without whom a society can not last very long.
alternatives: There are people without whom a society can not last very long.
There are people without whom society cannot last very long.
There are persons without whom society can not last very long.

items.text: It is true that he is poor but smart.
alternatives: It is true that he is poor but clever.
It is true that he is poor but intelligent.

items.text: I think it true that he is poor but smart.
alternatives: I think it true that he is poor but clever.

items.text: I think it is true that he is stupid and rich.
alternatives: I think it is true that he is foolish and rich.
I think it true that he is stupid and rich.

items.text: Who he is is not known to all.
alternatives: Who he is is not known to everyone.
Who he is is not known to everybody.

items.text: Who he is is not known to anybody.
alternatives: Who he is is not known to anyone.
Who he is is known to nobody.
Who he is is known to no one.

items.text: There was not a girl that was not kind.
alternatives: There was no girl that was not kind.
There was no girl who was not kind.
There was not a girl who was not kind.

items.text: He is not such a man as tells a lie.
alternatives: He is not such a man as tells lies.
He is not such a man as would tell a lie.

items.text: He has as many books as you have.
alternatives: He has as many books as you do.
He has as many books as you.

items.text: I have the same watch as you have.
alternatives: I have the same watch as you do.
I have the same watch as you.
I have the same watch as yours.

items.text: It is natural that you be disappointed at not passing the exam.
alternatives: It is natural that you should be disappointed at not passing the exam.
It is natural that you are disappointed at not passing the exam.
It is natural that you are disappointed about not passing the exam.
It is natural that you should be disappointed at failing the exam.
It is natural that you are disappointed at not passing the test.

items.text: When you are going to do anything, keep it in mind that you should do your best.
alternatives: When you are going to do anything, keep it in mind that you must do your best.
If you are going to do anything, keep it in mind that you should do your best.
When you try to do anything, keep it in mind that you should do your best.
When you are going to do anything, keep it in mind that you have to do your best.
